name: Torly Booking
author: torly

sections.description:
Torly is an appointment scheduling system for small businesses. This plugin puts the booking page of your Torly business on your WordPress site, so your visitors book an appointment without leaving it.

You need a Torly account with a published booking page. Paste the address of your booking page in the plugin’s settings and choose how to show it:

  • A button that opens a window over the page with your booking page in it.
  • The booking page inside the page, at the place you choose. Its height follows its content.
  • A button that opens the booking page in a new tab.
  • A floating button in the corner of every page, or of the home page only.

Add it with the “Torly Booking” block, or with the shortcode [torly_booking].

The booking itself is made by Torly: your services, staff, working hours, booking rules and messages are the ones you set in Torly, and every appointment appears in your Torly calendar. The plugin stores no customer data on your site.

The booking page is available in Hebrew, English, Arabic, Russian, Georgian, Turkish, Dutch and Spanish. It follows the language of your site, or the language you choose.

The shortcode

  • [torly_booking] — a button that opens the booking page in a window over the page.
  • [torly_booking mode="inline"] — the booking page inside the page.
  • [torly_booking mode="link"] — a button that opens the booking page in a new tab.

Options: text (the button’s text), lang (he, en, ar, ru, ka, tr, nl, es), height (the inline frame’s height in pixels before the page loads), slug (the address of another Torly business, for a site that shows more than one).

Without JavaScript

Every button is a plain link to your booking page, so a visitor whose browser runs no JavaScript still reaches it.

For developers

  • The torly_booking_show_floating_button filter decides, page by page, whether the floating button is shown.
  • When an appointment is booked, the page receives a torly:booked event on document. It carries no detail about the booking.

External services

This plugin connects to Torly (https://torly.cc), the service that holds your booking page. It cannot work without it.

  • When you save the plugin’s settings, your site’s server asks Torly whether the business address you typed exists (https://torly.cc/api/public/business/{address}). Only that address is sent. The answer (the business’s name and whether its booking page is published) is kept on your site for an hour.
  • When a visitor opens the booking window or a page with the inline booking form, the visitor’s browser loads your Torly booking page (https://torly.cc/{address}) in a frame. As with any web page, Torly receives the visitor’s IP address and browser details, and whatever the visitor types into the booking form (for example a name, a phone number and an e-mail address) goes to Torly and to your business’s Torly account. The booking page may also use Google Analytics, as described in Torly’s privacy policy.

The plugin loads no script from Torly into your site’s pages; the booking page runs inside its own frame.

Torly’s terms of use: https://torly.cc/terms
Torly’s privacy policy: https://torly.cc/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin and activate it.
  2. Open Settings › Torly Booking.
  3. Paste the address of your Torly booking page (in Torly: My Site) and save. The plugin tells you whether the address was found.
  4. Add the “Torly Booking” block to a page, or the shortcode [torly_booking], or switch on the floating button.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Torly account?

Yes. The plugin shows the booking page of a Torly business. You can open an account at https://torly.cc.

Where do the appointments go?

To your Torly calendar, like any appointment booked on your Torly booking page. Nothing is stored in WordPress.

My business takes full payment in advance. Does it work?

Yes. A payment is never taken inside a frame: the visitor sees a short note and continues on your Torly booking page, in a new tab, where the booking and the payment are made.

Can a customer sign in with Google or Apple inside the window?

Some browsers block those sign-in windows inside a frame. E-mail and password work in the window, and a link under the sign-in buttons opens the full booking page in a new tab.

Can I show more than one business on the same site?

Yes. Give the shortcode the other business’s address: [torly_booking slug="another-business"].

Can I change the button’s look?

The button uses your theme’s button style. The floating button’s colour and text are set in the plugin’s settings.
